summary: Depth-4 follow-on to the n-tuple leaf: added the depth-4 arm (Arm::NTupleD4) to the ntuple-scale crate, its screen and query binaries and a depth-4 determinism gate on the frozen tables; wrote the theory, the preregistered two-by-two leaf-by-depth experiment and its fresh lease; ran the gates and the one-shot 512-game screen of the unchanged frozen tables at depth 4 beside depth 3 and the fair leaf at both depths; wrote the analysis, the result record, the approach page section, the web figures and the log entry.
validationPerformed: cargo test --release (12 unit tests, including the depth-4 arm's legality, determinism and work ordering)
gate binary on the frozen tables (gate --weights): all CHECK gates including leaf-in-d4-search-determinism (gates.log)
analyze.py evaluated the preregistered gate, the persistence criteria and the interaction verdict from the screen artifact; compare.py reports written for six contrasts
node --experimental-strip-types --test src/bench/bench.test.ts (the two n-tuple playground policies), npx tsc --noEmit and npm run lint under web/
the screen's per-game artifact, analysis, gate log and resource log were published to the public research archive and verified (runs/RUN-20260906T081306Z-e62d9837/published.jsonl)
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.

The owner chose this direction from the model's written list of follow-ons and asked for the run, the report and a playground submission of the depth-4 policy; the model designed the two-by-two protocol, the gate and the interaction verdict, and ran it on the same workstation as the two earlier experiments.
